correctness.rationale: Exact bijection between a^k residuals and bounded compositions of the m distinguished symbols across b+1 gaps. Uniform gap composition under fixed content, rational one- and two-mark variable generating functions, and coefficientwise smoothing yield every asserted finite identity; Stirling establishes the exact rate. Direct mask enumeration covers all q-ary words for q=2 lengths 0..11, q=3 lengths 0..8, q=4 lengths 0..7; an independent weak-composition/series comparison verifies 21,648 second-moment cells. The all-length proof is symbolic, not empirical.

value.rationale: The fixed-content model is a natural complete ensemble of a new residual-word combinatorial observable. Its all-depth conditional moment law, exact second moments, and sharp symmetry-point exponential mean/extremum separation are informative natural invariants, not isolated finite counts. The fraction of maximizing hosts and the mean diverge at distinct exponential bases, quantifying worst-case versus average-case ambiguity. No downstream capacity theorem is required or claimed.
